# Evolving Nexus

> A transformational learning and research initiative founded by Nish Dubashia
> and Marie Murtagh, exploring consciousness, meaning and the structure of
> reality through live online programs, research, writing and dialogue.

Evolving Nexus brings together insights from psychology, philosophy, science,
spirituality and human development to explore two fundamental questions: how do
we find meaning, and how is reality structured?

The work is grounded in the conviction that no single tradition, discipline or
worldview contains the whole picture. Understanding ourselves and our world
requires a deeper conversation, one capable of holding together inner and
outer, reason and spirituality, ancient wisdom and contemporary knowledge,
individuality and relationship, being and becoming.

Through courses, research, writing and dialogue, Evolving Nexus is developing
an integrative approach to consciousness, meaning and human transformation.

Something new is evolving: this site is currently a coming-soon page and the
full site is in development. As Evolving Nexus takes shape, the mailing list is
where the growing conversations around living consciously in a rapidly changing
world are shared.

## Two paths of exploration

Four programs are organized around two complementary streams.

**The Meaning of Life** explores consciousness, human development,
relationship, purpose and transformation.

- *The Architecture of Human Consciousness*. Explore how human consciousness
  develops, how different perspectives shape our experience of reality, and how
  expanding awareness can deepen our understanding of ourselves, others and the
  world we inhabit. Drawing on developmental psychology, philosophy and
  contemplative wisdom, this program offers a richer understanding of human
  identity, meaning and transformation. Six sessions.
- *The Seven Principles*. Explore seven fundamental dimensions of human
  existence: Spirit, Self, Suffering, Hope, Knowledge, Salvation and Love.
  Bringing philosophy, psychology and the world's spiritual traditions into
  dialogue, this program offers an integrative framework for exploring life's
  deepest questions and discovering new possibilities for meaning,
  understanding and transformation. Eight sessions.

**The Structure of Reality** explores the deeper patterns through which
consciousness, cosmos and reality may be understood.

- *The Diamond Paradigm: Fundamentals*. Discover the foundations of the Diamond
  Paradigm, an original integrative framework for understanding the deeper
  structures and relationships underlying reality. Explore how apparently
  opposing perspectives can reveal complementary dimensions of a greater whole,
  and how this understanding can illuminate consciousness, existence and
  everyday life. Six sessions.
- *The Diamond Paradigm: Advanced*. Deepen your exploration of the Diamond
  Paradigm through its advanced philosophical, developmental and nondual
  dimensions. Examine the deeper relationships between consciousness, reality
  and transformation, integrating multiple perspectives while exploring the
  dynamic interplay of unity, diversity and the evolving whole. Eight
  sessions.

All programs are taught live and remotely by both founders, in cohorts that
move through the material together. Cohorts run across the United States and
Europe. Every program is taught using the OMEGA framework, the school's own
teaching methodology.

## The Diamond Model

The Diamond Model is Nish Dubashia's own framework for understanding the
structure of reality, developed over four decades of study across philosophy,
science and the contemplative traditions. It is the basis of the Structure of
Reality programs and is his own work rather than a synthesis of other people's.

## Founders

**Marie Murtagh**, Co-Founder. Researcher, educator and integrative thinker
whose work explores consciousness, human development, meaning and
transformation. Came from information technology and served many years as Chief
Operating Officer of an international training organization. Draws together
psychological insight, philosophical inquiry and contemplative understanding,
with a particular interest in how our ways of knowing shape our experience of
ourselves, others and the world.

**Nish Dubashia**, Co-Founder. British author, philosopher and educator.
Background in mathematics and more than four decades of engagement with the
world's philosophical and wisdom traditions. Author of *Gifted*, *Dancing with
Angels*, *The Unity of Everything: A Conversation with David Bohm*, *A Brief
History of God* and *The Book of Becoming* (co-authored with Hans Plasqui and
Daniela Bomatter), with a sixth in progress. Creator of the Diamond Model. Has
presented at the Global Forum at MIT, UNESCO World Philosophy Day in Paris, the
Integral European Conference and the Science of Consciousness Conference.

## Recognition

Three endorsements of *The Book of Becoming: An Integral Nondual Manifesto for
a World in Transition*, co-authored by Nish Dubashia, Hans Plasqui and Daniela
Bomatter.

Ken Wilber, pioneering Integral philosopher and author of *The Integral
Vision*: "This is a superb book, highly recommended. Among other things, it
dialogues between Integral Theory and AI—arguably one of the most important
conversations that the postmodern world can engage in. It does so with clarity,
intelligence, and deep insight."

Michael Bernard Beckwith, Founder and CEO of the Agape International Spiritual
Center and author of *Life Visioning* and *Spiritual Liberation*: "The Book of
Becoming arrives as a timely and compelling invitation to meet this moment in
human history with spiritual depth, evolutionary vision, and conscious
participation."

Dr Jude Currivan, Oxford physicist, cosmologist and co-founder of
WholeWorld-View: "The Book of Becoming is both an invitation and realisation of
an inescapable truth: meeting the meta-crisis of this pivotal time requires a
collective shift in consciousness. I applaud and am deeply grateful for its
clear and courageous call to practical action, both inner and outer, and for
its compassionate essence of urge-agency and hope."

## Frequently asked questions

**Who is Evolving Nexus for?**
Evolving Nexus welcomes coaches, consultants, facilitators, leaders,
therapists, educators, researchers, contemplative practitioners and independent
thinkers. What unites them is a curiosity about consciousness, human
development, meaning and reality. No prior study is required.

**What will I learn in an Evolving Nexus program?**
You will explore how consciousness develops, how perspectives shape
understanding, and how deeper insight enriches life. The Meaning of Life stream
covers consciousness, development, relationship and purpose, while the
Structure of Reality stream investigates the patterns underlying existence.

**What is the Diamond Model?**
It is Nish Dubashia’s original framework for understanding the structure of
reality, refined over four decades across philosophy, science and the
contemplative traditions, and the foundation of the Structure of Reality
programs. It is his own work rather than a synthesis of other people’s ideas.

**Do I need a background in philosophy or psychology?**
No. Our introductory programs are accessible without prior academic study.
Whether you are new to these questions or have explored them for many years,
Evolving Nexus offers opportunities to deepen your understanding, connect
different perspectives and participate in meaningful dialogue.

**How long are the Evolving Nexus programs?**
One live session a week, plus reading or practice in between. Courses run six
or eight sessions depending on which one. They are taught as seminars rather
than lectures, so the discussion carries much of the learning.

**How are Evolving Nexus sessions run?**
Live and remote, with both Marie Murtagh and Nish Dubashia present, in a cohort
that moves through the material together. Cohorts run across the United States
and Europe, and session times are set so people in both can attend live.

**What happens when I join the Evolving Nexus mailing list?**
You receive occasional reflections on consciousness, meaning and reality, and
word of new courses, research and events as they are announced. One email to
confirm, and nothing you did not ask for.

## Topics

Consciousness studies, integral theory, nondualism, philosophy of mind, human
development, developmental psychology, transformational learning, philosophy of
religion, the Diamond Model.
